title: MZ sword scabbard for RPG Maker MZ Character Generator

posts.author: PIKACHU64
posts.body:
Hello, I'm PIKACHU64, and I have a question. Is there a scabbard for the RPG Maker MZ Character Generator? I've been looking for one since November or September because I'm a Ys fan and I love the scabbard design from Ys 10. That's why I'm asking about resources for the MZ. Can anyone help me, or is there no scabbard for the Character Generator? (P.S. The resource should be for the generator and should be usable for both unofficial and official games.) Thank you.
Yours, PIKACHU64
